SUMMARY: FernFactory procedurally builds a 3D fern via Blender geometry nodes: a fern is a cluster of pinnae (fronds), each pinna carries pinnules (level-2 stems) along a curved rachis, and each pinnule instances flat leaf meshes generated by LeafFactory. The upper-level files define the leaf silhouette (leaf_general.py), the nested frond geometry-node graph and fern assembly (fern.py), and mesh helper utilities. Note: the actual recursion is fixed at two structural levels (pinnae → pinnules → leaf meshes), not three fully self-similar levels; deepening the fractal nesting requires editing geo_fern/geometry_pinnae_nodes.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/small_plants/fern.py
  FernFactory.create_asset: top-level entry; sets default params and builds fern.
    knobs: fern_mode(random pick "young_and_grownup"|"all_grownup") -> mixed young+mature vs all-mature fronds; scale(0.02 fixed) -> overall fern size; version_num(5) -> number of distinct pinna shape variants per frond side; pinnae_num(randint 12..30) -> number of fronds in cluster; leaf genome leaf_width(0.4)/width_rand(0.04) -> leaflet silhouette width & variation
  FernFactory.debug_asset: single-frond debug build.
    knobs: fern_mode("single_pinnae" fixed); scale(1.0); version_num(5); pinnae_num(1); age(uniform 0.5..0.9) -> maturity/curl of the frond
  geo_fern: assembles multiple pinnae into a fern; handles the three fern_mode layouts.
    knobs (young_and_grownup mode): flip_bit(randint 0..3) -> up vs down-facing fronds; rotate_z(uniform 2.74..3.54 flipped / -0.4..0.4) -> frond azimuth; rotate_x(uniform 0.8..1.1) -> frond tilt; rotate_z2(uniform 0..6.28) -> spin; random_age(uniform 0.7..0.95) -> maturity; random_leaf_num(randint 15..25) -> leaflets per pinna; random_pinna_num(randint 60..80) -> pinnae segments per frond; young_num(randint 0..5) young frond count with random_age(0.2..0.5), leaf_num(14..20), pinna_num(60..100), rotate_x(0..0.4)
    knobs (all_grownup mode): rotate_z(normal 3.14,0.2); rotate_x(uniform 0.5..1.1); random_age(0.7..0.9); random_leaf_num(16..25); random_pinna_num(60..80)
    knobs (single_pinnae mode): leaf_num_param(20 fixed); pinna_num_param(60 fixed)
    final geometry scaled by params["scale"].
  check_vicinity: rejects overlapping frond orientations.
    knobs: thresholds abs(dy)<0.1, abs(dz)<0.15 -> min angular spacing between fronds
  geometry_pinnae_nodes: builds one frond (rachis + pinnae + leaf instances).
    knobs: leaf_num_param(18) -> leaflets per pinna; age_param(0.4) -> curl/scale maturity; pinna_num_param(40) -> pinnae along rachis; version_num_param(4) -> shape variants; gravity_rotation(1) -> droop direction; pinnae_contour (two random modes, [0,0.2,0.6,1.4,3.0,4.0,5.0,6.0] or ..4.2, +normal(0,0.04*i) noise) -> frond outline taper; per-version pinna_contour k(uniform 0.5..0.58), clip(0..0.7) -> individual pinna taper; leaf_num jitter randint(-1,2); level2 instance scale map_range 6..8; noise SetPosition Scale 0.4 Roughness 0.2 -> surface jitter
  random_pinnae_level2_curvature: samples per-pinna curl curves.
    knobs: z_max_curvature(uniform 0.3..0.45); y_curvature_noise(clip|normal(0,0.2)|,0,0.3); y_curvature_k(uniform -0.04..0.2) -> pinnule bend along z/y
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_yaxis_rotation / _zaxis_rotation: per-pinna twist.
    knobs: curvature (normal(0,0.3) clip±0.4 / normal(0,0.2)) -> frond yaw/roll curvature profile
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_gravity_rotation: droop.
    knobs: curvature(uniform 0.25..0.42 * gravity_rotation) -> gravitational bending strength
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_xaxis_rotation: rachis pitch curve.
    knobs: FloatCurve points fixed; MapRange out -1.5..0 -> pitch magnitude
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_stein / _level2_stein: stem geometry.
    knobs: L1 radius mult 0.01, circle radius mult 15, Resolution 10; L2 radius mult 0.1, circle radius mult 0.5, Resolution 10 -> stem thickness/roundness
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_scale: pinna size along frond.
    knobs: MapRange out 1.0..3.0 -> pinna size gradient
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_instance_position: spacing of pinnae; MapRange out 0.3..4.5 -> frond length vs age
  nodegroup_pinnae_level1_instance_rotation: MapRange 2..3.1 -> pinna twist range
  nodegroup_pinnae_level2_rotation: pinnule curl; MapRange 1.2..0 (z) -> curl vs age
  nodegroup_pinnae_level2_set_point: pinnule spacing; MapRange out 0.5..2.0 -> pinna length vs age
  nodegroup_pinnae_level2_instance_on_points: leaf placement; Transform scales (1.2,-1,1)/(1.2,1,1) -> mirrored leaflet pairs; rotation X 1.57; MapRange 6..8 -> leaf size vs age

FILE: assets/objects/small_plants/leaf_general.py
  LeafFactory: generates a single flat leaflet mesh.
    knobs: scale(0.3 class attr) -> leaflet size; genome leaf_width(0.5 default,0.4 used) -> width; alpha(0.3) -> tip curvature phase; use_wave(True) -> add wave modifier ripple; x_offset(0); flip_leaf(False) -> mirror; z_scaling(0) -> out-of-plane cupping; width_rand(0.33 default,0.04 used) -> width randomness; wave modifier height(randn*0.3), width(0.75+randn*0.1), speed(rand) -> ripple shape

FILE: assets/objects/small_plants/__init__.py
  module exports; no tunables.

FILE: assets/objects/trees/utils/mesh.py
  mesh helper library (vertex selection, extrusion, sampling, finalize). Only select_vtx_by_idx / finalize_obj used by LeafFactory; no fern-specific knobs.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/materials/plant/simple_greenery.py -> green leaf/plant surface shader applied to the fern
  assets/materials/plant/__init__.py -> plant material registry
  assets/colors.py, core/util/color.py -> color sampling utilities
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py -> NodeWrangler / Nodes API for building geometry-node graphs
  core/nodes/node_utils.py -> to_nodegroup decorator, assign_curve helpers
  core/nodes/node_info.py, compatibility.py, utils.py -> node type definitions & version compat
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (seeding, asset lifecycle)
  core/placement/detail.py -> level-of-detail placement support
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod to attach geometry-node modifier to object
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> tag_object semantic labeling
  core/util/blender.py -> butil helpers (delete, SelectObjects, apply_transform)
  core/util/math.py, random.py -> math/random utilities
  core/util/logging.py -> logging
  assets/utils/object.py -> object creation utilities
  assets/objects/trees/utils/helper.py (via mesh.py import) -> set_active_obj and low-level object helpers
